title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for E_n as derived from the integration.

title: Use of Correspondence Principle
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Bohr correspondence principle to relate quantum and classical frequencies.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration process leading to the final expression for E_n.

title: Correct Variables
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the variables E, n, alpha, beta, and E_0 in their calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student may check that units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect integration limits.
